en.title: Choosing RoRo or Container Shipping for a Vehicle to Latin America
en.seo_title: RoRo vs Container Vehicle Shipping to Latin America: The Evidence to Collect First
en.meta_description: No Latin American port-authority or car-carrier primary document was captured, so this page gives the evidence list to collect (port, terminal, carrier, route, operability, securing, weight declaration, insurance, release) and the one verified Incoterms rule; it concludes no RoRo-versus-container choice.
en.summary: Mode choice is decided by the carrier and port for a specific sailing. This page states only the verified Incoterms 2020 distinction and the dated, named confirmations you must obtain; it asserts no port rule, service, schedule, rate or EV/used/damaged acceptance position.
en.method: An evidence-collection framework; only the Incoterms 2020 distinction is stated as a verified rule, and international securing/weight-declaration provisions were not re-verified this round.
en.ai_disclosure: Prepared by the AutoBridge Export Editorial Team with AI assistance for source organization, drafting, revision and translation. This is AI-assisted independent review, not human editorial sign-off; final editorial review is pending.
en.evidence_boundary: No first-hand booking, sailing, inspection or shipment is claimed. No Latin American port-authority or car-carrier primary was captured; port rules, carrier services/routes/schedules/rates and EV/used/damaged-vehicle acceptance are not asserted and must be confirmed in writing before booking.

zh.title: 车辆出口拉美的滚装与集装箱运输如何选择
zh.seo_title: 滚装还是集装箱：车辆出口拉美先要收集的证据
zh.meta_description: 本页未采集到拉美港口当局或汽车运输船承运人的一手文件，因此给出须收集的证据清单（港口、码头、承运人、航线、可移动性、绑扎、重量申报、保险、放货）与唯一已核验的 Incoterms 规则，不给出滚装/集装箱选择结论。
zh.summary: 方式选择由承运人与港口针对具体航次决定。本页只陈述已核验的 Incoterms 2020 区分，以及须取得的带日期、具名确认；不主张港口规则、服务、船期、费率或电动车/二手车/受损车受理立场。
zh.method: 证据收集框架；只有 Incoterms 2020 区分作为已核验规则，国际绑扎与重量申报条款本轮未重新核实。
zh.ai_disclosure: 由 AutoBridge Export Editorial Team 编写，AI 协助完成来源整理、起草、修订与翻译。这是 AI 辅助的独立审阅，并非人工编辑签发，最终编辑审阅仍在进行中。
